conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and diversifying, but still carries market exposure.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Buy LMT at 4% and NVDU at 3% to add quality tech names.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a diversified approach.
It keeps total adds within total trims plus a cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech, while keeping leverage small and concentration managed.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing each to 6% for leveraged exposure.
Buy LMT at 6% and NVDU at 5% from the strongest scanner setups.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It uses and adds leveraged ETFs, which can lead to significant drawdowns and daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for steady monthly distributions.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
